description:
Reid Kielder 1 | Gravel bike

Versatile, capable and built for adventure – the ideal entry-level performance gravel bike for exploring new trails, tackling everyday commutes and heading out on longer bikepacking journeys.

The Reid Bikes Kielder 1 is designed to open up a world of riding possibilities, combining gravel-focused geometry with a lightweight aluminium frame and practical features for exploring beyond the tarmac. Whether you're looking for a rugged commuter, your first bikepacking bike or a versatile all-rounder, it's built to handle everything from everyday journeys to weekend adventures.

Its custom aluminium frame balances low weight, comfort and durability, providing a confident riding position for reliable control across roads, gravel tracks and off-road trails. Updated geometry improves stability and handling on uneven terrain, while generous tyre clearance gives you the flexibility to tackle a wider range of surfaces. With mudguard and equipment mounts, the Reid Bikes Kielder 1 is also ready to be customised for commuting, carrying luggage and longer adventures.

A Shimano Claris 2x8 drivetrain provides a versatile range of gears for tackling steep climbs, flat roads and rolling gravel routes. The comfortable STI shifters integrate gear changes and braking controls, making it easier to shift smoothly while maintaining a secure grip on the handlebars. Tektro cable-actuated disc brakes with 160mm rotors deliver dependable stopping power and control in a variety of weather conditions.

Rolling on CST Overton 45mm tyres, the Kielder 1 offers a practical balance of fast-rolling performance on paved roads and grip on loose or uneven surfaces. A comfortable saddle and lightweight aluminium finishing kit complete the setup, helping keep the bike manageable and comfortable on longer rides.

With its versatile gearing, adventure-ready frame and practical mounting options, the Reid Bikes Kielder 1 offers excellent value for riders looking to explore more. From the daily commute to gravel routes and multi-day bikepacking trips, it's built to help you venture further with confidence.

The Kielder 1 is ideal for:

Gravel riding and off-road exploration, with gravel-focused geometry designed for confident handling across mixed terrain

Everyday commuting, with a lightweight aluminium frame and practical mounts for mudguards and accessories

First-time bikepacking adventures, with equipment mounts for carrying luggage and essential gear on longer journeys

Riders tackling hills and varied routes, with Shimano Claris 2x8 gearing for a versatile range of riding conditions

Comfortable, controlled gear changes, with Shimano STI shifters integrating shifting and braking controls

Reliable all-weather braking, with Tektro cable disc brakes and 160mm rotors for dependable stopping power

Road and trail versatility, with CST Overton 45mm tyres that combine efficient rolling on tarmac with grip on gravel

Longer rides and bigger adventures, with a comfortable saddle, lightweight aluminium components and a confidence-inspiring riding position

Riders seeking an affordable performance gravel bike, combining practical features and versatile capability for commuting, exploring and bikepacking
